h: Anne Hathaway reportedly welcomes third child
p: Actress Anne Hathaway and her husband Adam Shulman have reportedly welcomed their third child. She was photographed with a newborn in New York.
body: Hollywood actress Anne Hathaway and her husband, jewellery designer Adam Shulman, have reportedly welcomed their third child.
The Devil Wears Prada star, 44, was photographed on 17 November 2026 walking around New York City with a friend, carrying a newborn in a baby carrier.

Hathaway announced her pregnancy in June with an Instagram video showing her baby bump. She later joked on a talk show that the couple had been surprised it happened, calling the baby their buzzer-beater.
Hathaway and Shulman are already parents to two sons, Jonathan, 10, and Jack, 7.
